L0521

A complete ASCII case ladder repeats a direct case conversion

What

A complete ASCII case ladder repeats a direct case conversion

Why

All 26 constant ASCII branches inspect the same value and only change its case

Fix

Replace the complete ladder with value.to_ascii_lower() or value.to_ascii_upper()

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0521: tests/ui_lint/complete_ascii_case_ladder.warn.

Warning [L0521] (complete_ascii_case_ladder): A complete ASCII case ladder repeats a direct case conversion
  --> tests/ui_lint/complete_ascii_case_ladder.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     value := "The Quick Brown Fox"
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: All 26 constant ASCII branches inspect the same value and only change its case
 Fix: Replace the complete ladder with value.to_ascii_lower() or value.to_ascii_upper()
